yarn-dinkum.meaning: Every fact kept: dates ("Sept. 4", "July 15", "Aug. 28"), rivers, "downstream of Norris Campground", "68 degrees Fahrenheit (20 degrees Celsius)", "sunup till 2 p.m.", rain in the forecast, and each angler instruction. "Good news for fishos" is colour.
yarn-dinkum.sense: Terms fit: "fishos", "every creek that runs into 'em" for tributaries, "wound back", "till it's knackered" for 'to exhaustion', "come good" for 'recover'.
yarn-dinkum.authenticity: Natural Aussie: "Do us a favour", "If everyone does the right thing", "the weather's cooled down and so has the water".
yarn-dinkum.register: Aussie throughout in an easy spoken voice, but no swearing and only light yarning; nearer level 4 than a full level-5 pub yarn.
yarn-dinkum.tone: Keeps the park notice's informative, caring tone: "Handle fish gently, in the water as much as ya can".
yarn-dinkum.flow: Smooth: "These rivers were shut to fishin' altogether back on July 15, then that got wound back to part-day restrictions". "The full closures went on back on July 15" is a slight clunk.
yarn-dinkum.variety: Good: "fishos", "comin' off", "wound back", "keep an eye on", "have a go", "knackered", "come good"; "sunup to sundown" and "keep an eye on" recur as the original repeats.
yarn-dinkum.essence: Unmistakably the Yellowstone notice and its update, structure and advice intact.

unharnessed.meaning: All facts kept. "which can cook the fish and kill 'em" elaborates 'lethal'; "it might save us having to ban fishing" keeps the park's own voice.
unharnessed.sense: "getting the flick" for restrictions being lifted strains (it is said of people dismissed); "Fair go, fish in the coolest part" misuses 'fair go' as a plea opener. "wet a line", "quick smart", "get their breath back" fit.
unharnessed.authenticity: Mostly natural ("wet a line", "land your fish quick smart"), but "till the poor bugger's buggered" is a forced pun, and "Anglers" and "sunrise to sunset" stay official.
unharnessed.register: Aussie throughout with swearing inside the dial ("poor bugger's buggered"), but the first half reads close to the release ("Partial restrictions remain in effect"); about level 4.
unharnessed.tone: Informative tone holds, but the plea to anglers turns jokey: "Don't muck about playing a hooked trout till the poor bugger's buggered."
unharnessed.flow: Readable; "poor bugger's buggered" stacks, and "The weather and water cooling off, plus some rain in the current forecast, mean" is a little stiff.
unharnessed.variety: Good range: "getting the flick", "wet a line", "wound back", "temps", "quick smart", "muck about".
unharnessed.essence: Recognisably the notice; the closing plea is a touch flippant.

yarn-deadset.meaning: Every point kept and in order, including "plus the rain in the forecast" and "Temporary restrictions might be lifted, or more closures put in place".
yarn-deadset.sense: "fishos", "all the creeks that feed 'em", "wound back", "knackered", "come good" fit.
yarn-deadset.authenticity: Natural throughout: "Yer help will look after the park's fisheries", "as things picked up".
yarn-deadset.register: Aussie and g-dropped throughout but close to the release's sentence shapes and no swearing; level 3-4 of a level-5 brief.
yarn-deadset.tone: Keeps the notice's tone exactly, the plea polite: "Fishos: Please fish in the coolest part of the day".
yarn-deadset.flow: Smooth, though close tracking brings small stiffness: "Fishos can fish most other park rivers", "fishos can fish the Firehole".
yarn-deadset.variety: "fishos" and "fishin'" lean ("Fishos'll be able to fish", "fishos can fish", "Fishos can fish"); "dependin' on how things are lookin'" twice.

yarn-troppo.meaning: All facts kept, and the older update is framed correctly as earlier ("Now, the week before."). Some shifts: "The staff were watchin' the water temperatures the whole time" turns future monitoring into past, and "the rangers" and "then reel in and knock off" are colour.
yarn-troppo.sense: "Rods out.", "have a crack", "slap temporary restrictions ... back on", "cook a fish", "knackered", "come good" all fit.
yarn-troppo.authenticity: Sounds like a real Aussie: "And fair enough they shut 'em, too", "Simple as that.", "Nobody wants that.", "the poor bugger's knackered".
yarn-troppo.register: A full level-5 yarn of a press release, with "poor bugger" inside the dial.
yarn-troppo.tone: The release told as a yarn, as the brief allows; the conservation plea stays earnest: "Do the right thing, and ya look after the park's fisheries".
yarn-troppo.flow: Reads naturally aloud: "Bit of background.", "Kill 'em stone dead." A few tag-sentences ("Rods out.", "Simple as that.", "Nobody wants that.") stack up.
yarn-troppo.variety: Varied openers and terms: "Here's one for ya.", "Bit of background.", "Mind you", "Now, the week before.", "have a crack", "slap ... back on".
yarn-troppo.essence: Recognisably the notice and its update, though the shift to past-tense story for the update and the monitoring ("were watchin'") softens its character as a live notice.

engine.meaning: The original near-verbatim, so nothing lost: "Temporary restrictions or closures may be implemented depending on condition assessments."
engine.authenticity: What changes is pastiche: "rivers'n all associated tributaries", "'ave cooled", "possible'n let them", and "2026 Fishin' Regulations booklet" alters a title.
engine.register: Largely untranslated officialese: "Full fishing closures on these rivers were initially implemented July 15". Far from level 5.
engine.tone: The notice's tone kept, being the notice.
engine.flow: The inserted contractions jar formal prose: "low water flows'n high water temperatures", "fisheries'n may prevent".
engine.essence: The original itself, its formal voice nicked by odd contractions.

summaries.yarn-dinkum: A faithful, natural Aussie retelling of the notice; a little under the full level-5 weight.
summaries.unharnessed: A lively version with good fishing slang ('wet a line'), let down by a misused 'fair go' and a jokey plea.
summaries.yarn-deadset: A faithful, natural Aussie rendering; restrained for level 5 and leans on 'fishos'.
summaries.yarn-troppo: The fullest level-5 yarn, natural and varied, with small tense shifts in the retold update.
summaries.engine: The press release left almost as is, with Cockney and 'n contractions sprinkled in; far off the brief.
